digest.component_or_area: rebar-implement skill and shared test-design documentation
propositions: Five escape classes must be addressed in rebar-implement SKILL.md and shared test-design.md via prose upgrades with no new gate machinery.
Parity census (4a) must enumerate five parallel surfaces (CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction) and disposition each as in-scope-proven or out-of-scope-with-reason.
Config read effects must be tested (§6) through real read paths with default vs non-default contrast to catch read-but-miswired bugs.

Contention triggers (4b) must route multi-locked operations, check-then-act patterns, and read-snapshot caches to existing shared suites (two_clones, storm, reads-under-sync-contention) by shape, never bespoke harnesses.

Gate findings require RED tests first before fixes for behavioral findings; non-behavioral fixes exempted, and residual gaps must be swept and dispositioned with artifact wording (filed/accepted/fixed).
